not_validated: allocator peak memory or storage release

outcomes.name: staged_norm_backward_and_saved_state
outcomes.decision: Frozen FP32 standalone norm needs the actual staged derivative for these exact CPU results. Reject universal compact-formula, FP16-saved-input, or reconstructed-input equivalence.

outcomes.name: norm_unique_saved_storage_and_trainable_fallback
outcomes.decision: Native frozen norm already saves only x/r/w storage. Deduplicating five references to three is not a storage saving; recomputing r removes only its tiny referenced storage in this toy inventory and adds unmeasured work.

outcomes.name: residual_alias_outputs_and_branch_association
outcomes.decision: Standalone norm exactness does not establish residual-fusion exactness. Native graph branch accumulation can change 0 into 1 under regrouping; retain both outputs, alias handling, version checks and branch-order validation.

outcomes.name: rope_fp32_layout_broadcast_and_adjoint
outcomes.decision: Split-half pair adjoints match the tested FP32 strided/broadcast/unequal-head contracts. Preserve actual output strides and unused-gradient None semantics; this is not runtime Qwen dtype or CUDA evidence.

outcomes.name: rope_saved_storage_and_dtype_fallback
outcomes.decision: Native frozen-coefficient RoPE already saves cos/sin, not q/k. Four-to-two saved references is no unique-storage saving. Keep FP16/mixed/trainable-coefficient cases on reference until separately validated.

outcomes.name: rope_wrong_layout_inverse_and_contraction
outcomes.decision: Reject interleaved rotation and generic inverse-RoPE adjoint assumptions. FP32 contraction can change valid split-half/trig outputs; preserve multiply/add rounding unless separately accepted by actual gates.
